name: Responsive Layout and Typography
description: Defines SCSS styling standards, including BEM class naming conventions, forbidden direct media queries in favor of library mixins, and typography class usage rules for UI components.

name: Design Tokens and Styling Guide
description: Architectural reference for design tokens, properties.json configuration, token resolution, and SCSS integration in the @dxtmisha/d1 component library. Provides exact standards for token hierarchies, semantic palettes, typography presets, and component styling rules to assist AI coding agents.

name: SCSS Color and Palette Guide
description: Defines SCSS standards, rules, and mixins for applying text colors, icon strokes, SVG fills, and dynamic palette theming using system tokens. Solves the technical task of maintaining consistent, theme-reactive styling without hardcoded values across UI components.

name: SCSS Background Guidelines
description: Rules and mixins for configuring background colors, surface opacities, gradients, and backdrop filters in SCSS using the dxtmisha library. Defines best practices for token-aligned, theme-adaptive styling and dynamic palette bindings.

name: SCSS Sizing Guide
description: This file contains standards, rules, and mixins for managing component dimensions, spacing tokens, and dynamic viewport units in SCSS. It helps AI agents generate consistent sizing, width, and height rules for UI components.

name: SCSS Spacing Guide
description: This document contains standards and mixins for implementing padding, margin, and gaps in SCSS with full bidirectional RTL and LTR support. It provides an AI coding assistant with rules for using logical properties and standard 4px-based spacing tokens to build adaptable UI components.

name: SCSS Border and Divider Guidelines
description: This file contains SCSS coding standards, mixins, and rules for implementing borders, outlines, dividers, and dynamic palette borders using the `@dxtmisha/d1` library. It solves technical styling tasks by enforcing explicit property separation, color token handling, and opacity management for component design systems.

name: SCSS Outline Guidelines
description: This file contains SCSS styling standards and mixins for implementing accessible focus rings, outline opacity, and dynamic palette outlines. It guides AI agents on how to correctly apply non-shorthand outline properties and theme bindings for interactive UI components.

name: SCSS Elevation Guide
description: Guidelines and standard system tokens for applying box shadows, backdrop-filter blur effects, and depth elevation in SCSS UI components.

name: SCSS Border Radius Guide
description: Defines standards, tokens, and rules for applying corner radii, pill shapes, and adaptive height-relative border-radius scaling in SCSS for the @dxtmisha/d1 design system.

name: SCSS Typography Guide
description: This file contains standards and mixins for SCSS typography, text sizing, and multi-line clamping using the @dxtmisha/d1 library. It solves technical tasks related to consistent font styling, bidirectional alignment, and text truncation across web interfaces.
